title: Solar camera aimed at the portal spot on fenced-off ranch
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Solar camera aimed at the portal spot on fenced-off ranch, about 2025 at Bradshaw Ranch, Sedona, Arizona, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: pointing exactly at the point where Linda Bradshaw says she saw the portal.

plain: Ross Coulthart, a guest who says he found a UFO base in Arizona, says that in 2025 he saw a solar-powered camera on the fenced-off Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona. According to him, it was pointed exactly at the spot where a woman named Linda Bradshaw says she saw a portal, a kind of doorway to somewhere else. He takes it as a sign that someone is still watching that spot closely.
